adopted_rules: one complete product, three dimension lines along real edges
excluded_elements: values 36/26/21 cm as facts (shown only as source-stated)

adopted_rules: spec block separate from the drawing to avoid line clutter
lines outside the product, product complete

tokens.palette_note: accent comes from the job palette; --accent-ink is computed from the accent's luminance when the palette lacks it; a light accent (L>0.4) turns the eyebrow to --muted

fonts.display: Archivo 850 wdth 114% (headline, en uppercase; unit always lowercase)
fonts.numbers: Archivo 800 wdth 90% (pills, table values) - one display family, no condensed second face
fonts.zh: Noto Sans SC 700/900; figures stay in Archivo

table.style: white card, 1px rules, full-height dividers, ink figures

elements.note: product name (+ ' · ' stock phrase), darkened accent; zh no tracking, '·' without spaces
maxLines 2; figures headline (class dimhl) W × D × H + lowercase accent unit when headline_dims applies
axis names centred under each headline figure (WIDTH / DEPTH / HEIGHT, 宽度 / 深度 / 高度); fall back to W / D / H when they would collide
scaled by a fit search so product + lines + pills (+ the turned view) fill the free region; cap 1.25; 30° diagonal when content is longer than 2.2:1 and there is no turned view

job.end: the same product turned a quarter (from the end, or from the front for a tool seen from above), drawn at the same scale (job.end.scale) right of the main view on its ground line (at right) or under it with left ends lined up (at below), its own dimension lines (dN after the main ones)
lines flatter than 45°: one-line pill turned to the line; steeper lines: upright stacked pill (figure over the other unit) beside the line
table mode, only for figures not on the drawing + job.specs (job.table_all lists W/D/H too, in headline order); left out when empty
one pattern: '<source>; please allow 1–2 cm variance.' / '<来源>，存在 1–2 cm 误差'; no source → 'Sizes are approximate…' / '尺寸为近似值…'

adaptation_rules: dimension lines run parallel to from→to, offset 50px (dim.offset / job.dim_offset) beyond the content box on the dim.side normal; ends are the hull extremes projected onto the line; dim.at is no longer used
values: 'value unit / converted unit' in one pill; in→cm ×2.54, cm→in ÷2.54, mm→in ÷25.4, all to 0.1
product + lines + pills are fitted together into the region between header and table/footer and the product is centred on the canvas axis when room allows
long products (content aspect > 2.2) lie on a diagonal rising to the right (job.tilt, default 30°; job.rotate forces an angle, 0 disables)
dim_pad is accepted for compatibility but no longer used: the fit computes the room the lines and pills need
one figure order everywhere: length-or-width × depth-or-thickness (or width after a length) × height (headline, axis keys, table)
table mode: columns = figures not already drawn + job.specs, at most 6; with nothing left the table is dropped and its space goes to the product (noted); job.table_all=true keeps W/D/H columns

headline_dims (optional, default 'stock'): stock or missing headline becomes the figures ('40.5 × 18 × 47.6 cm'), unit lowercase in the accent in every language; stock phrase joins the eyebrow; true forces, false keeps job.headline; needs ≥2 figures in one unit
headline_keys (optional, default true): axis names under the headline figures
the figures headline stays on one line: compact 72 step, then shrinks to ≥56px
dim_style (optional, default 'arrows'): 'ticks' draws 24px bars square to the line

disclaimer: job.disclaimer as given (ranges get an en dash, '1-2cm' → '1–2 cm'); else table_note's source sentence + variance clause; job.variance sets the range or false drops it (default '1–2 cm', '0.5–1 in' for inch jobs)

only the sizes the job gives are drawn (the set builder passes only sizes the user stated); a size the main view hides goes on job.end, the product itself turned a quarter at the same scale; there is no schematic depth box and no depth pill
limitations: demo_only: all photos are third-party reference images with unverified rights; original branding kept, not replaced
all copy is neutral visual description, not approved product claims
elements above are the measured layout of the main render; real layout is computed by the template rules for each job
